provenance.scope: Full pretrained T5-small greedy generation, then one full teacher-forced forward pass of the actual generated prefix. All six encoder/decoder blocks; attention head 1; vector slices explicitly labeled.

input.text: translate English to German: The house is wonderful.

operations.label: Token embeddings
operations.description: Source and decoder tokens use the same learned 512D embedding table. T5 supplies position information through relative attention biases.
operations.formula: xᵢ = E[tokenᵢ]

operations.label: Encoder self-attention
operations.description: Every source token can attend to every source token. The matrix is a full recorded head, including relative-position bias.
operations.formula: Aenc = softmax(QKᵀ + relative position bias)

operations.label: Final encoder memory
operations.description: All six encoder blocks finish before cross-attention reads their final normalized states. This same source memory feeds every decoder block.
operations.formula: memory = RMSNorm(Encoder₆(…Encoder₁(Esource)))

operations.label: Decoder prefix embeddings
operations.description: The actual generated prefix, shifted right by the T5 start token, is fed into the decoder. The first decoder token is <pad>.
operations.formula: decoder input = E[<pad>, generated tokens before this step]

operations.label: Causal decoder attention
operations.description: The decoder sees the generated prefix. Future positions are masked to zero. <pad> is T5’s decoder start token.
operations.formula: Adec = softmax(QKᵀ + relative bias + causal mask)

operations.label: Encoder → decoder attention
operations.description: Queries come from the decoder; keys and values come from the encoder’s final output. Each row shows which source tokens a decoder token reads.
operations.formula: Across = softmax(Qdecoder Kencoderᵀ); context = Across Vencoder

operations.label: Feed-forward + residual
operations.description: Each T5 block applies RMS normalization, a 512 → 2048 → 512 ReLU feed-forward network and a residual addition. These are recorded decoder FFN inputs and outputs.
operations.formula: FFN(x) = Wo ReLU(Wi x); hidden = residual + FFN(RMSNorm(hidden))

operations.label: Vocabulary probabilities
operations.description: The final decoder state projects through the shared embedding table. These are the next-token probabilities after the full recorded output prefix (normally EOS).
operations.formula: p(next token) = softmax(E × hidden / √512)

tensors.name: Top next-token probabilities
tensors.slice: Top 8 of 32,128 vocabulary entries; probabilities are not renormalized
